# Temple Scroll Column 43 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 43 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**43:1** Every creature that walks upon its paws among all four-footed creatures is impure to you.

**43:2** Whoever touches their carcass shall be impure until evening.

**43:3** Whoever carries their carcass shall wash his garments and be impure until evening; they are impure to you.

**43:4** These shall be impure to you among the creatures that swarm upon the earth: the weasel, the mouse, and the great lizard according to its kind.

**43:5** The gecko, the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the sand lizard, and the chameleon.

**43:6** Anyone who touches their carcass shall be impure until evening; whoever carries their carcass shall wash his garments and be impure until evening.

**43:7** Anything upon which any of them falls when dead shall become impure — whether a wooden vessel, a garment, a skin, or a sack.

**43:8** Any implement used for work shall be immersed in water and remain impure until evening; then it shall be clean.

**43:9** Every earthen vessel into which any of them falls — its contents shall be impure, and the vessel shall be broken.

**43:10** Any food that may be eaten upon which water from such a vessel comes shall be impure; any liquid that may be drunk from such a vessel shall be impure.

**43:11** Every swarming creature that swarms upon the earth is an abomination; it shall not be consumed.

**43:12** Whatever moves on its belly, whatever moves on all fours, whatever has many legs among all swarming creatures on the earth — you shall not consume them, for they are abominations.

**43:13** You shall not render yourselves abominable with any swarming creature, nor shall you make yourselves impure through them so as to be defiled.

**43:14** For I am the LORD your God; you shall consecrate yourselves and be holy, for I am holy.

**43:15** You shall not defile yourselves with any swarming creature that moves upon the earth.

**43:16** For I am the LORD who brought you up from the land of Egypt to be your God; you shall be holy, for I am holy.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 43 parallels Leviticus 11:27-45 on carcass contamination and forbidden swarming creatures. LOGOS renders sheqetz as "abomination" (vv. 11-13) in its formal cultic sense. The identification of specific creatures (vv. 4-5) remains uncertain; renderings follow scholarly consensus. The holiness imperative (vv. 14, 16) forms an inclusio with Leviticus 11:44-45.*
